title: Update on the Collateral Ratio Under Portfolio Margin and the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance will update the  collateral ratio  for the following assets under Portfolio Margin on  2025-07-22 06:00 (UTC) and 2025-07-25 06:00 (UTC).  The update will be completed within approximately  30 minutes . The following assets will be adjusted on  2025-07-22 06:00 (UTC) :  Assets Collateral Ratio (Before) Collateral Ratio (After) FLOKI 40% 50% PENGU 30% 50% TAO 30% 50% SXT 10% 30% FXS 20% 30% RESOLV 10% 20% The following assets will be adjusted on  2025-07-25 06:00 (UTC) : Assets Collateral Ratio (Before) Collateral Ratio (After) DASH 55% 45% BAT 50% 40% EGLD 55% 40% FLOW 55% 40% COTI 40% 30% DENT 40% 25% In addition, Binance Futures will update the leverage and margin tiers of the following USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts at  2025-07-25 06:30 (UTC)  as per the tables below. The update will be completed within approximately one hour. Please note: Existing positions opened before the update  will be affected ; Futures running grid might  expire  due to updates on the leverage and margin tiers, users are advised to adjust accordingly before the change.
